name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: An autonomous multi-skill marketplace that audits any public website for AI discoverability and on-site engagement barriers, producing evidence-backed findings.

skills.description: Safely coordinates a read-only public website audit, composes specialized skills, and emits one structured report.
Audits crawler access, raw content, structured facts, and render-only content traps.
Checks sampled first-party facts for material contradictions and entity ambiguity.
Performs bounded browser checks for modal traps, unnamed controls, and navigation blockers.
